subject: Erasure: prompts, outputs & request logs — scope and confirmation
messages:
From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-dataops@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Complete erasure of prompts/outputs/logs for project ACME-2026-09

Hi Nikhil / Monica,

We are requesting a formal purge of all artifacts Redwood holds for the ACME-2026-09 integration. Scope needed: all prompt inputs, assistant outputs, transient KV cache items produced during inference, and request/response logs tied to project ID ACME-2026-09 (including any request traces persisted in S3 or object store). To be clear, we expect: 1) deletion from active stores, 2) removal from any short-term caches, and 3) a statement about backups and whether older snapshots will be affected.

Please confirm the full list of storage locations you will sweep, an estimated timeline for permanent deletion, and the form of confirmation you will provide (we prefer a signed attestation / DocuSign). We also need a simple manifest of what will be deleted (file paths / prefixes) and any audit hashes you can provide for chain-of-custody.

We are in the US region for this workload. Compliance team requested completion within 5 business days if possible. Let me know if you need more info. I have attached the filled erasure request form.

Thanks,
Jill Turner
Head of Data Ops, Acme Health
Attachment: erasure_request_form.pdf

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Complete erasure of prompts/outputs/logs for project ACME-2026-09

Thanks Jill — acknowledged. We can execute a purge that covers prompts, assistant outputs, and request logs for the ACME-2026-09 project. A couple quick clarifying questions before we start: 
- Please confirm whether you want deletion from backups/snapshots as well (these are handled on a longer cadence and may require a separate approval).
- Do you require deletion of aggregated telemetry and aggregated usage metrics, or only raw per-request artifacts?

Planned immediate actions: I will spin up a dedicated runbook and a manifest that enumerates object prefixes and DB keys we will remove. Ops will perform the following staged work: a pre-sweep verification, the purge job, and a post-sweep verification with manifest hashes. I attached the initial manifest CSV (list of candidate prefixes) for your review.

Proposed timeline: pre-sweep verification today, purge window Friday Oct 12 22:00 UTC, final confirmation Oct 12–13. If you need an accelerated window we can prioritize but will need signed acceptance on the scope.

Thanks — I will assign Monica to own the sweep and produce the attestation.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: acme_erasure_manifest_20261009.csv

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acmehealth.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Complete erasure of prompts/outputs/logs for project ACME-2026-09

Hi Jill — assigning ops steps and runbook below. Quoting Nikhil's plan and my additions.

Runbook (summary):
1) Freeze new write activity for project ACME-2026-09 (token routing policy) — 30 minutes before sweep.
2) Snapshot current metadata and publish pre-sweep manifest (we will attach a signed pre-sweep manifest).
3) Purge object store prefixes (S3):
   - s3://redwood-prod/requests/acme/ACME-2026-09/inputs/
   - s3://redwood-prod/requests/acme/ACME-2026-09/outputs/
   - s3://redwood-prod/kvcache/acme/ACME-2026-09/
   - s3://redwood-prod/traces/acme/ACME-2026-09/
4) Delete corresponding DB rows in request_logs table: DELETE WHERE project_id = 'ACME-2026-09' and shard ids X/Y/Z (we will run within a transaction and archive the transaction id for audit).
5) Invalidate and clear any in-memory/redis caches linked to project keyspace.
6) Verify no active replicas remain in the US region; schedule cross-region replication pause where necessary.
7) Post-sweep verification: produce a post-sweep manifest, compute SHA256 over concatenated path list, and include operator signature.

Notes on backups/snapshots: Our standard snapshots are retained for 30 days and live in a separate S3 bucket (s3://redwood-backups/). Deleting from backups requires escalation to the backup custodian team and typically triggers a longer retention reconciliation (we estimate 7–10 business days). If you require immediate backup deletion, we need explicit approval from Acme's legal/compliance and a signed order.

Proposed purge window: 2026-10-12 22:00 UTC (48-hour recovery window after final verification)
Deliverables: signed pre-sweep manifest (PDF), post-sweep manifest (CSV + SHA256), final attestation (DocuSign). I attached the runbook snapshot for your records.

If that timeline works, please reply with: 'Approve purge as scoped' and the contact for the DocuSign signature.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
Attachment: erase_runbook_snapshot_20261010.pdf

Regards,
Nikhil Sharma
